trigger: Parallel rubric review (4 subagents, one per language batch, config/review_rubric.yaml attached) of all 23 gate-accepted locales from wave-cellsrust-quickstart-retrigger-20260911r3 (content/docs.aspose.org/en/cells/rust/getting-started/quickstart.md) returned REJECT for all 23/23, unanimously on the same two defect classes recurring at the identical structural position in every file -- all 44 automated zero-defect gates had passed every one of these cells.
goal: Root-cause the two recurring defects per plan SS10 before retriggering, so the fix (not just the symptom) ships and this page does not need a third pass.

defect_1.symptom: Heading '### Prerequisites' and table header cells 'Requirement'/'Detail' left byte-identical to English in all 23 reviewed locales (also present in the 2 review-agent-unreached it/zh cells, which failed for an unrelated reason -- see defect_class note below).
defect_1.root_cause: text_unit_extractor.py's _is_non_translatable() checks the i18n template-string registry first (is_translate_eligible) and only falls back to the legacy single-hump PascalCase heuristic (_is_technical_identifier, `^[A-Z][a-z0-9]{3,}...$`) when no registry entry exists. 'Prerequisites'/'Requirement'/'Detail' matched that heuristic's shape (any capitalized 4+-letter single word) with no registry entry to short-circuit it -- the exact same bug class already fixed for 'Issue'/'Cause' (TC-APT-108) and 'Encryption' (TC-APT-053), confirmed by direct extraction against the real source file (classify_unit returned allowed_identical/protected_unit before the fix).
defect_1.verified_not_assumed: Ran TextUnitExtractor + classify_unit directly against content/docs.aspose.org/en/cells/rust/getting-started/quickstart.md; printed do_not_translate=True for all 3 units pre-fix, do_not_translate=False (requires_translation) post-fix.

defect_2.symptom: Two full list-item sentences ('... typed cell setters.' and '`display_string_value` -- the cell's display text when reading values back.') entirely untranslated in all 23 locales -- a full explanatory sentence, not a short fragment RB-003 would excuse.
defect_2.root_cause: _is_technical_identifier's snake_case check was `"_" in text and text.islower()`, which matches ANY text containing an underscore anywhere with zero uppercase letters -- not just a standalone snake_case identifier. Both bullets are full lowercase prose sentences that merely MENTION a snake_case identifier (`put_value_string`, `display_string_value`), a shape common across the whole Rust/Python/Go documentation portfolio wherever a bullet list describes API members in prose, not limited to this page.
defect_2.verified_not_assumed: Same direct-extraction method; confirmed both units flip from do_not_translate=True to False after anchoring the regex to `^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$` (whole-string match).

defect_3_deferred_not_fixed_this_pass.symptom: Frontmatter description missing-space glue before a protected API identifier (e.g. cs 'pomocíWorkbook.save', de 'mitWorkbook.save', ru 'с помощьюWorkbook.save', sv 'medWorkbook.save'), 8 of 23 reviewed locales.
defect_3_deferred_not_fixed_this_pass.assessment: Not a deterministic extraction bug -- placeholder_manager.restore() does a literal substring substitution of the protected value at the exact span the model's OWN generated text placed it; the space loss happens during LLM generation around the {PLACEHOLDER_N} token, not at protect()/restore() time. A blanket 'insert a space before any restored placeholder value' repair would be wrong for script-without-word-spacing locales (th, and arguably zh/ja) in this same 25-locale set, so it needs a script-aware repair, not a quick anchor fix.
defect_3_deferred_not_fixed_this_pass.disposition: Deferred as a new, separate Track-B finding (not blocking this retrigger). If it recurs after this retrigger for the same 8 locales, file individual heal tickets per plan SS10 rather than re-guessing a portfolio-wide repair without more evidence across other pages.
